findings.summary: The page renders the bibliography section title as a second h1.
findings.consequence: Assistive-technology heading navigation exposes both the author name and the bibliography panel as top-level page headings, making the bibliography title look like a separate page rather than a subsection of the author page.
findings.evidence: The owned template renders the author name as an h1 at line 292 and then renders `Bibliografisk databas` as another h1 at line 314. Existing SSR and visual tests assert `.page_content h1`, so the current tests preserve the duplicated page-level outline.
findings.recommendation: Use an h2 for the inner `Bibliografisk databas` heading and preserve visual styling with a class or CSS selector that does not depend on h1 semantics; update tests to assert the text or accessible heading level accordingly.
